items.title: Connect a bank account to the Stripe account
items.notes: external_accounts is 0. Checkout Sessions work and can be created and cancelled, but no money can land until a bank account is connected. This is the single thing between KRYSYS and actual revenue.

items.title: Resolve the GitHub account billing lock
items.notes: GitHub Actions reports 'your account is locked due to a billing issue'. It is account-wide, not repository-wide. Until it clears, no workflow can be trusted as a gate.

items.title: Replace the revoked ElevenLabs API key
items.notes: The key in 1Password returns 401. The account and the 44 voices are intact; only the dashboard key is dead.

items.title: The 1Password CLI rate limit cleared
items.notes: The CLI was rate limited, so the vault could not be refreshed. It cleared: a new item 'OpenAI Platform Key - Codex project' was created and read back with --reveal, and the older 'OpenAI Project Key' was left untouched.

items.title: Fix the HERETIK MCP route
items.notes: HERETIK was never an MCP server - /mcp 404s while /health is fine. The dead reference was an [mcp_servers.unityMCP] HTTP entry in C:/Users/KING/.codex/config.toml pointing at HERETIK's 8080. Removed after a backup; the working Unity stdio relay was kept. ChatGPT recovered in the same pass and served an exact token.

items.title: Fix the TESSERACT project venv
items.notes: The project-local test environment has no fastapi, which causes 21 collection errors. Pre-existing, and it hides real failures.

items.title: ChatGPT worker quota resets
items.notes: The Plus worker quota is a rolling cap, and a 429 is now classified as 'blocked' rather than 'failed'. The integration itself is proven - it served exact nonces, wrote 386 bytes of working code and completed a real file task in 34.6s.

items.title: Publish the faraday identity rewrite
items.notes: reality-engine carried 85 local-identity commits. Rewritten with the history-preserving rewriter and published: 85/85 now read as dqikfox, 15 third-party commits preserved, and main was left untouched at 94 third-party commits. A bug in the publisher - a remote ref table read after it was needed - was found and fixed on the way.

items.title: The all-branch audit is clean
items.notes: The whole account: 68 repositories, 352 branches, zero unlinked local identities, zero errors. The API auditor pages through every commit of every branch and could not finish - it was still running after 20 minutes with 34 of 68 done. A fast auditor now does the same work in one local pass per repository, 12 seconds for the 173-branch repository against 884, with the API kept for the proof, a per-repository control and a positive control. A planted offender is scanned first, so a clean result means something.

items.title: Scrub the retired KRYSYS credentials from history
items.notes: The defaults were removed from the working copy but remain in the history and in server.js.premonetary.bak. Rotate first, then scrub.

items.title: Land the IBM 30-day trial gains before it expires
items.notes: Local, permanent outputs only - catalogues, glossaries, deduplicated data. No long-term cloud dependency.

items.title: Keep the estate clean - no regressions
items.notes: The house must stay green. 262 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed, and the gate at 100.0/100 across 37 checks.

items.title: Store the OpenAI Platform key in the vault
items.notes: The key authenticates - GET /v1/models returns 200 - but the project has no credit, so a completion returns 429 credit_balance_exhausted. A valid credential that cannot pay is blocked, not failed. It is now an item in 1Password with the verdict in the note; the old 'OpenAI Project Key' was not overwritten.

items.title: Publish the GOLD AU Evidence Atlas on a stable public URL
items.notes: Served on 8767 because 8766 belongs to QMS, and QMS answers 200 as well - so the probe is body-aware. The stable URL is the Tailscale Funnel at https://throne-1.tail886dbb.ts.net/, with a quick tunnel as a secondary. The launcher proves the public body against the local body before it exits. /health answers JSON so the estate gate can read it.

items.title: Resolve the 8080 Cradle/HERETIK port collision
items.notes: The invalid Codex reference to 8080 is gone, but the underlying ownership overlap between Cradle and HERETIK is still open. PORT_MAP records it as resolved-for-mcp for Codex only.
